capturedBy: live pair-details probe through the S10 driver (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome), 2026-08-25, while the pair was still bonding; archived at scratchpad/s10/raw/. Selected from a 5-pair live scan of the near-graduation launchpad board because the archived wave-3 GOGH/BARK captures were tool OUTPUT rather than wire bytes and those two curves had moved on by the time this fixture was cut.
note: S10-1: the pair's OWN pool/bonding-curve account is returned as HOLDER ROW 0 of the token holder list, holding 25.19 percent. Counting it as a whale is what inverted the concentration ranking for this token class (measured on GOGH: top10 71.90 with the curve counted against 24.17 without, and on BARK 37.18 against 20.59). The row `id` equals the pairAddress in the request, which is the whole evidence the exclusion needs and it is in the same document. Solana holder rows use `id`/`balance`/`percentage` and state percentage ALREADY as a percent, unlike the GoPlus fraction on the ethereum fixture.
